subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 3 — product consolidations (review request)

question: Should an existing `systemAgent.rescue.enabled: false` configuration continue to block owner-DM remote rescue after this consolidation, or should the project intentionally remove that operator safety control?
rationale: The patch changes a persisted operator choice into an enabled policy on eligible hosts, and only maintainers can decide whether that security posture is an intentional supported-product change.

options.title: Preserve explicit disablement
options.body: Keep an explicit opt-out or doctor migration outcome that prevents rescue for users who had disabled it, while retiring only the other rescue tuning knobs.

options.title: Retire the opt-out deliberately
options.body: Accept that eligible YOLO hosts always expose owner-DM rescue and document the resulting security and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Pause the rescue cut
options.body: Land unrelated consolidations separately and defer the rescue policy removal until its supported safety contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit disablement
recommendation.body: Keep an explicit opt-out or doctor migration outcome that prevents rescue for users who had disabled it, while retiring only the other rescue tuning knobs.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch groups the rescue-policy removal with the broader product consolidation and documents it as a requested maintainer decision.
